earned_by: TRIPLE-SYSTEM-20261027-001A proved the polynomial side (abelian triple system, every class). The hardness side (ticket C) needs the steering rule of BEYOND-CLASS2-20261027-001C for general nilpotent groups: the change of the layered obstruction by a cabled pure braid with conjugators in the third lower central term is the degree-3 Lie part of the conjugators evaluated on the bundle values of all free minus classes (layer 1 and deeper), paired with the dual classes. Scoping (scoping/README.md) confirmed it for u4, free class 3 on two minus generators and a class-4 cross-layer algebra on three fixtures, and found no obstruction for the abelian cross-layer class-3 algebra. This contract tests it on new algebras (three generators, mixed signs, class 4 with free layer-2 and layer-3 classes), gadgets, p = 11, against an independent matrix model and an independent group-law count.
question: Is the four-way form of G = N x| C2 on gadget surgeries exactly the Dynkin-evaluated degree-3 Lie part of the cable conjugators on all free minus classes, for six nonabelian triple systems of class 3 and 4 at p = 5, 7, 11; do bases and abelian triple systems never obstruct; and do an independent matrix model and group-law count agree?

public_inputs.algebras: tsfix.algebras: u4; free nilpotent algebras (lm.free_nilpotent) of class 3 on (y1-, y2-), (y1-, y2-, y3-), (x+, y1-, y2-), of class 4 on (x+, y-) and (x+, y1-, y2-) (layer-1 data on y1 only); abelian: free class 3 on (x+, y-), class 4 on (x+, y-) modulo [y,[y,[x,y]]], Heisenberg (y1-, y2-)
public_inputs.fixtures: tsfix.fixture_words and base_words (braids, cables and gadgets of BEYOND-CLASS2-20261027-001B-E001's fixtures.py)
public_inputs.measurement: lm.LieBraidModel: closed-braid presentation of S^3_2, labels as (BCH vector, theta-parity), layers solved in order, the measured top-layer minus obstructions paired with (J^T s, 0)

predictions.R0_abelian: cross3 (x+, y-), cross4 mod [y,[y,[x,y]]] and heisenberg (y1-, y2-): on every fixture, 16 random free data in every minus component lift
predictions.R1_steering: for u4, free3 (y1-, y2-), free3 (y1-, y2-, y3-), free3 (x+, y1-, y2-), cross4 (x+, y-) and free4 (x+, y1-, y2-) with layer-1 data on y1 only: on 4_1 x4 + P4 (0,0) and gadget K3 (p = 5), T(2,p) x8 + P4 (0,1) + P4B (3p,0) (p = 5, 7), gadget C4 (p = 7), T(2,11) x8 + P4B (0,1) (p = 11): Q = 2 sum_events sum_j sum_b <W_j^(3)(ell(x))>_b ell_j(s_b) on all 32 samples, with x all free minus data (including layer-2 and layer-3 classes)
predictions.R2_base: T(2,p) x4 (p = 5, 7) and 4_1 x3 (p = 5): no algebra obstructs
predictions.R3_model_agreement: u4: the BCH model equals the matrix model of BEYOND-CLASS2-20261027-001B-E001 on the same samples, on the four fixtures at p = 5, 7
predictions.R4_lifting: free3 (y1-, y2-) on 4_1 x4 + P4 (0,0) at p = 5, 24 layer-1 data (8 with c_y2 = 0): the direct count of BEYOND-CLASS2-20261027-001A with fixed layer-1 data is positive exactly when Q(x; .) = 0, and then equals |Z1|^2

controls.machinery (any failure makes the run inv: M1 sparse bracket equals the dense structure-constant contraction; M2 BCH (degree <= 4) associative on random triples; M3 inverses; M4 on every R0/R2 fixture, Fix has dimension summands + 1 and (J^T s, 0) annihilates the minus linear part (p = 5, 7, 11 for M1-M3)
controls.negative (each must show a mismatch, els: X1 kappa = 1 and X2 the P4B tensor for a P4 insertion (free3 (y1-, y2-) on 4_1 x4 + P4); X3 one edge dropped (free3 (x+, y1-, y2-) on gadget K3); X4 leaves 0 and 2 swapped and X5 the rule with layer-1 data only (cross4 (x+, y-) on gadget K3)

decision_rule: Invalid if a machinery check fails or a negative control matches. Supported if R0-R4 hold on every fixture. Refuted otherwise, naming every failed item; neither predictions nor construction change after this contract.
stop_rule: Run run.py once; no adaptive extension.
environment: workspace .venv python (numpy); BEYOND-CLASS2-20261027-001B-E001 (fixtures.py, mlib.py, bm.py), cp_lib.py and bc_lib.py imported read-only
red_team_r0: 32 samples per fixture test a polynomial identity at random points, not every point.

Class-4 steering is tested where the layer-3 part of the conjugator value vanishes or the layer-3 obstruction is absent (free4 restricted to y1; cross4 with one minus generator): the non-central case (two layer-1 directions with nonzero triple brackets) is not exercised, because there the layer-3 obstruction blocks layer 4 on generic samples; ticket C covers it by characters.
Prediction and measurement share the colourings (layer-1 inputs) and the Magnus tensors of the braids; the model agreement (R3) and the group-law count (R4) are the independent routes.
No class 5 or higher: the BCH truncation is exact only to class 4.
nonclaims: No claim for class 5 or higher, p = 2, 3, or non-graded algebras.
